contract.density: n0=nsat*(1-3*Lsym*I^2/(Ksat+Ksym*I^2)), the quadratic bulk-energy-per-baryon stationarity approximation.
contract.residual: model nuclear binding energy per baryon (negative convention) minus data

cuter.claim_limit: Related author-team implementation substantiates a concrete calibration option; it is not evidence that Scurto M1-M5 used this four-parameter curvature fit or its weights.

source_version_check.history: Only v1 listed in acquired abstract page.

lower_crust.prescription: BSk22 below nB=0.002 fm^-3; no exact pressure/chemical-potential joining/reference prescription located in these inspected sources.
lower_crust.published_method: Fourth-order ETF with perturbative proton shell/pairing SI, damped Fermi nucleon profiles, Wigner-Seitz Coulomb.
lower_crust.solver_availability_result: Paper confirms Python/SciPy rewrite of earlier Fortran and missing inverse configurations recovered; bounded search did not locate a public full BSk22 ETFSI source archive. Ioffe linked routines are analytic fits. CUTER is CLD/meta-model, not full BSk22 ETFSI.
